title: Book's claim of alien contact at Bentwaters, disputed by witnesses

tellings.quote: about that there was actual contact with aliens at bent wers in 1980

plain: The book Left at East Gate claims that in 1980 there was actual contact with aliens at RAF Bentwaters, an air base in England used by the US Air Force, where strange lights were reported. The documentary maker James Fox brings up that claim with Michels and says the witnesses dispute it: the airmen Jim Penniston, John Burroughs and Cabansag and the officers Charles Halt and Gordon Williams. As Fox tells it, the people who were actually there do not back the book's account of a meeting with aliens.
